The screenshots show no staff header, preview banner, or stretched image. Primary shows the approved lesson crop. Reading omits its staff controls. Tutor keeps the leaderboard ratio. Storytime fails only where its CSS frame cuts the face.
Missing optional photographs render no empty image blocks, as D7 permits. The CodeCamp blank area comes from card height, not a missing photograph placeholder. No new image is required to fix F2.

Accessibility snapshots capture headings, named links, image alternatives, disclosures, and table semantics. Nested main landmarks remain inherited from the existing marketing layout and page wrappers; this run does not claim unique main landmarks.

The routes contain static content, links, images, and native disclosures. They have no changed data-loading, form-error, or empty-data state to exercise. Normal image loading completed without a broken or empty slot.

Two initial interaction harness attempts produced no valid route evidence. The first lost stdin; the second expanded JavaScript route variables in the wrapper. The corrected node -e invocation used string concatenation and completed all 18 checks.

The reviewer stopped server PID 3416158, obtained from ss for port 3123. A final ss check confirmed that the port is free. No implementation, test, plan, registry, package version, or commit changed. This result replaces the stalled run's provisional build blocker.
Background stream files were temporary. This artifact preserves selected ARIA excerpts and all 18 browser measurements instead of citing expired stream paths. All 27 listed full-page captures exist.

The current branch and worktree remain for Green remediation and the later merge gate. Other branches and worktrees remain with their owning sessions. Daniel's Thai, look, push, and deploy gates remain closed.
